derry_home_flat.text: Come in, mind the cat. The mill was a linen mill once, and these flats keep the big windows.
'Houl yer whisht' is what you say here for 'be quiet'. Hear it from a grandmother and you will stop talking.

then.text: That is all I have, I am afraid. Off you go, and mind how you go.

else.text: The wee hootlets in the wood up the road keep very odd hours. I call them the night staff.
